embed.reason: TinyMCE 4 wrote <embed></embed>, and TinyMCE 8 self-closes it. Both parse the same.

styleattr.reason: TinyMCE 4 lowercased hex colors in style attributes, and TinyMCE 8 keeps their case. The color is the same.

bare url.reason: TinyMCE 4 bug: a stray closing tag from its wpview marker added an empty paragraph. TinyMCE 8 stores the input unchanged.

link around block.reason: TinyMCE 4 bug: it deleted a link wrapped around a heading. TinyMCE 8 keeps the link. An empty paragraph after it depends on browser timing, so both forms are allowed.

word paragraph.reason: Upstream moved the Word filter to the commercial PowerPaste. Open: plan task P5.7.

word list.reason: Upstream moved the Word filter to the commercial PowerPaste. Open: plan task P5.7. Fake bullets stay as text.

google docs.reason: TinyMCE 8 handles the Google Docs wrapper differently and adds a trailing empty paragraph. Open: plan task P5.7.

google docs table.reason: TinyMCE 8 keeps the inner paragraph in table cells and adds a trailing empty paragraph. Open: plan task P5.7.
